name: Minase Yukito
source:
The place where he had lost hope was picked up by Zaizen and became a butler.
Therefore, he has pledged absolute loyalty to his benefactor, Zaizen.
It is said that his high physical ability is related to his previous job, but Yukito's past is a mystery.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/nemurihime/chara/yukito_minase.html]official website[/url]]
